scope: local/test independent synthetic document server; HTTP GET /documents only
policy: unchanged zt-policy-2026.10.1; docs READ grant TTL 60 seconds
authorization: existing /zero-trust/protected-access atomically consumes one-use core grant
handoff: hashed bounded RAM capability, 3 second TTL, one-use GET/path binding; service-authenticated consume
deny_assertion: non-2xx, no protected fixture body hash, zero additional resource deliveries
allow_assertion: 200, exact protected fixture body hash, one additional resource delivery
concurrency: 8 requests share one core grant; exactly one resource delivery
limitations: No production adoption, independent teammate review or high-load SLA assertion
Core grant consumption is authorization point; revocation does not cancel an already authorized in-flight request
No atomic transaction spanning core journal and business action; delivery failure does not refund a consumed grant
Local internal HTTP only; production TLS/mTLS, OIDC/IdP mapping, HA and resource streaming are not validated
